responsibility: Defines the detailed DFA scheduler model for IBM POWER10. It models POWER10’s dispatch grouping, cracked even-slot requirements, execution/load/store units, and instruction-class latencies for scalar, vector, prefixed, crypto, HTM, DFP, and MMA operations, including bypasses where needed, so GCC’s RTL scheduler can pack and order rs6000 instructions according to POWER10 decode/issue constraints rather than just generic PowerPC timing.
